subject: Re: deadline confirmation
text: Hi, thanks for your note. I’m still clarifying dates before the block meeting. Could you confirm whether you need my quote by Friday or Monday morning, since you mentioned the committee may move it? I can work either way, but I want to avoid sending something too early or too late. Also, if any neighboring properties are still waiting, let me know which deadline applies, because I assumed all materials were due by the same day after your last reply.
